hypothesis: A live-safe candidate-source model built only from current-row Nero/PIC state can replace the offline signal != 0 gate and improve over prior all-rows/direct-bar baselines without using future-derived inputs.

decision_time.timeframe: H1 for historical labeled splits; current raw snapshot may be shorter diagnostic data and is not quality evidence
decision_time.moment: after the row/bar snapshot is written by MT4, before any future rows are known
decision_time.entry_assumption: trade entry is evaluated from the next executable bar/event after the signal export

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not use offline label_all().signal != 0 as a production candidate-source gate.
Do not use predict, ret_*, fav_*, adv_*, ret_dir_atr_lag1 as model inputs.
Do not tune thresholds on frozen test.
Do not continue direct-direction sweeps over the same fractal features without a new live-safe information source.

test.allowed_use: one frozen evaluation after validation freeze

forward.current_status: not available for ML quality proof in this stage
forward.minimum_rule: must be newer than frozen test and run with unchanged frozen rule

gates.validation_buy_sell_slice: both BUY and SELL slices must have PF >= 1.0 unless the hypothesis is explicitly one-sided before validation
gates.baseline_uplift: must beat direct_bar_model frozen baseline PF 1.1141 and all_rows_ranking frozen baseline PF 0.9134 on the same protocol; validation comparison first
gates.drawdown_gate: must be reported before candidate verdict; UNKNOWN is FAIL
gates.robustness_gate: year and side slices must be reported; UNKNOWN is FAIL
gates.live_safe_gate: all model inputs and candidate-source inputs must be live_safe; UNKNOWN is FAIL
